Disagreement.description:
One field on which a slice's matched leads materially disagree.

Recorded by the `/emery:plan` propose agent alongside a `divergence`
flag. The CLI never decides materiality — it only checks structural
consistency: a flagged slice records at least one disagreement, and
each disagreement names at least two distinct source values.

field.description:
The aspect the sources disagree on (a free-form label, e.g.
`password-min-length`).

values.description:
The per-source values that disagree on `field`. A genuine
disagreement records at least two distinct source values.

DisagreementValue.description: One source's value for a [`Disagreement`] field.

value.description: The value this source surfaced for the disagreeing field.

Divergence.description:
Slice-level reconciliation outcome.

Closed `none | likely | accepted | rejected` taxonomy on
`plan.yaml.slices[].divergence`, written only by `emery plan
amend`.

oneOf.description:
No divergence — the implicit default for slice records (absent
on disk) and the explicit first value of the journal
`plan.amend.divergence` `from` field on the first transition.

Staged by the `/emery:plan` agent after the reconcile write, via
`emery plan amend --divergence likely`, on
materially-disagreeing lead synopses.

Operator-stamped at Gate 1 — divergence acknowledged and
accepted into the plan.

Operator-stamped at Gate 1 — divergence rejected; the plan
must be re-proposed before Gate 1 review.

GateProse.description:
Gate 1 review prose riding a [`ProposalResponse`]: section bodies
only — the orchestrator owns every deterministic frame (`# Change —
<name>`, `# Discovery — <name>`, the `##` headings).

change.description:
The `change.md` operator brief body rendered below the
deterministic `# Change — <name>` heading: intent, scope, and
the Gate 1 review sections the skill flow authored by hand
(`## Tentative merges`, `## Cross-cutting leads`, `## Likely
divergences` when applicable).

discovery-source-inventory.description:
The `discovery.md` `## Source inventory` section body — one row
per bound source under `plan.yaml.sources.<key>`: key, adapter,
path or value. Body only, no heading.

discovery-summary.description:
The `discovery.md` `## Summary` section body — one-line counts
(`Sources: N. Leads: M.`). Body only, no heading.

ProposalKind.description:
Reconciliation envelope kind.

Serialises to the literal `"request"` / `"response"`.
[`ProposalRequest`] always carries
[`ProposalKind::Request`]; [`ProposalResponse`] always carries
[`ProposalKind::Response`].

oneOf.description: Lead catalog and project topology for the agent to group.

ResponseMember.description: One matched catalog row referenced by a [`ResponseSlice`].

lead.description:
Discovery lead id; with `source`, must match a request
catalog row.

source.description: Plan source binding key; must match a request catalog row.

ResponseSlice.description:
One `slices[]` row in a [`ProposalResponse`]: one slice of work
carrying its matched `sources[]` inline and its explicit `name`.

There is no `scope` noun and no kernel fan-out grouping. A body of
work that targets more than one project
is expressed as multiple ordinary slices (which may legally reference
the same lead) joined by `depends-on`; the agent's explicit `name`
disambiguates cross-source matches that carry differing slugs.

depends-on.description: Slice names this row depends on. Empty stays off the wire.

disagreements.description:
The per-field disagreeing values backing a `divergence` flag.
Recommended non-empty (with ≥2 distinct source values each) when
`divergence` is `likely`; the CLI advises on structural
consistency but never decides materiality and never blocks. Empty
stays off the wire.

divergence.description:
Agent-flagged slice-level divergence: `likely` when the matched
leads materially disagree. Absent means no divergence. The kernel
carries it onto `plan.yaml.slices[].divergence`; the operator
adjudicates `accepted` / `rejected` later via `emery plan amend
--divergence`.

name.description:
Explicit plan slice name (kebab-case). Required — with `scope`
gone the agent names every slice directly, and the kernel writes
it verbatim to `plan.yaml.slices[].name`.

project.description:
Project this slice binds to, chosen from the request's
`projects[]`. Optional only when exactly one project exists, in
which case the kernel auto-binds it.

rationale.description:
Optional cross-source-match rationale the agent renders into
`change.md` for Gate 1. Agent-authored and kernel-ignored — it is
not echoed into the journal.

sources.description:
Matched catalog rows, each referenced by `{ source, lead }`
(at most one per source). A lead may appear in more than one
slice — that is fan-out.

description: Generated judgment-answer schema — generated from the Rust wire types by project::answers; do not edit. Validates the schema-gated answer to the plan-time lead-reconciliation judgment: the `kind: response` envelope the guest `plan author` orchestration consumes. The deterministic tail re-checks the envelope kind and runs the projection kernel.

gate.description:
Gate 1 review prose authored alongside the grouping.
Canonically optional; the generated judgment-answer schema
requires it, and the collapsed `plan author` orchestration
persists it into `change.md` / `discovery.md`. The projection
kernel ignores it.

slices.description:
The agent's slices, in response order — the kernel writes
`plan.yaml.slices[]` in this order.

title: Emery plan reconciliation answer
